name: Curvature-Controlled Style Contours
definition: A contour generation method that regulates contour thickness based on the normal curvature along the view direction to avoid uncontrolled variation in thickness caused by flat vs. fine structures.
summary: Curvature-Controlled Style Contours is a volume rendering technique that maintains consistent contour thickness across varying surface geometries by regulating width based on normal curvature, avoiding the thickness variations of standard dot-product methods.
